text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way back from an outing 
with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Here is fine. I am going... to the 
mall—shopping mall—now.
choice_data_list:
If you're going shopping, I can come with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...I'm fine alone. It would only—be a 
burden to you.

Thinking a simple shopping trip wouldn't 
be much trouble, I decided to tag along, 
but...

Symboli Kris S ordered cookies at a 
confectionery shop, but...

text_block_list.name: Depachika Clerk
text_block_list.text: ...Um, it comes out to around this much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Much bigger――Even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Depachika Clerk
text_block_list.text: Well then... is this about right?

"Perhaps matching her gestures, the clerk 
also began explaining with hand and body 
movements."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Just... about this much.
choice_data_list:
What's been the matter with you for a 
while now?

What's been the matter with you for a 
while now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I attempted to order cookies... but I 
mistook—the unit of measurement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I told them in... ounces. ...180, it's 
very small.

I asked the clerk to wait a moment while 
we calculated, explaining that she had 
mixed up the units of weight. And then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
————5 kilograms! —I want to reserve 5 kg 
worth of cookies.

text_block_list.name: Depachika Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ah, 5 kg, correct? Understood.

—At a clothing store. Symboli Kris S 
repeatedly unfolds and refolds shirts, one 
after another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—The collar of this shirt— There's no 
way—it's only 3 cm."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Is this... the standard size in Japan? Or 
perhaps—

Looking at her, she seemed to be saying 
that based on the shirt's size number. 
Could it be that the sizing system is 
different from America's...?
choice_data_list: Why don't you try it on for now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Why didn't I think of that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I had gotten the units wrong 
again. I was... overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
âAll I have to do... is put it on and 
check. I'll be right back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —As expected... I have caused you trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I am... still unfamiliar with Japan. There 
are... many things I do not know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes... if only I had explained it... 
properly to you... from the very 
beginning...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, truly sorry.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you ever need help again.
American units are so confusing, huh?

American units are so confusing, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, truly sorry.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you ever need help again.
American units are so confusing, huh?

American units are so confusing, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —No. I won't cause any more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —However, I appreciate... your concern.

She's as earnest as ever... which only 
makes me worry about her all the more...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Meters and grams... are much harder for me 
to understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――It varies by country. ――Once you start 
getting into it, there's no end to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I just have to... get used to it.

She is right. However, knowing how serious 
she is, I worry a bit that she might 
overexert herself trying to get used to 
it...
